long_biography.plain_text:
SHV began as a coal trader and grew into a Dutch family conglomerate with interests in energy distribution, wholesale and other industries. Alicia Fentener van Vlissingen inherited a stake from her father Paul, a long-serving leader of the group. Her connection to the business has been through ownership rather than day-to-day management.

Beyond SHV, Alicia has supported the conservation organisation African Parks. Paul was an early financial backer, and after his death Alicia and her sister Tannetta committed funds to an endowment in keeping with his wishes. The endowment is designed to pay organisational overheads, keeping other donations available for work in the protected areas African Parks manages.
